answer: Detect sybils spectrally: build the attestation adjacency matrix and read its leading eigenvectors. A sybil farm joined to the honest oasis by only a thin bundle of attack edges forms a near-disconnected block, surfacing in a subdominant eigenvector set off by a small spectral gap — a violet band in a split spectrum. Dense internal vouching only sharpens that block across the sparse cut; it cannot fuse it to the honest core. A saffron-bright cluster isolated in a low eigenvector marks a manufactured region, since cheap internal edges never close the boundary outward.
